text:
Maya R: Quick sync — SOC2 sprint planning question. Legal just pushed back on our APAC pilot retention ask. They say auditors may expect longer for certain artifacts. Product needs a concrete ask: can we commit to 3y for most audit logs in the pilot, but keep longer for crypto/key proofs? cc @Ina (Legal) @Kevin
Ina (Legal): Auditors vary. For control evidence we usually aim for 3-5y; cryptographic key handshakes and keystore attestations are stickier. If we surface a clear mapping we'll be fine. Need explicit artifact list.
Jordan P: Proposal: pilot = 3y for streaming audit logs, 7y for keystore/keying evidence and signed evidence-packs. Customers who need longer get enterprise SLA. Thoughts?
Samir: Storage/cost note: 3y hot -> 7y cold-archive combo looks cheapest. We can auto-tier after 90d. Also can TTL-export to S3 glacier-like for long tail.
Kevin: Ops constraint: HSM vendor logs and KMS audit metadata are currently append-only and tied to our retention pipeline. We can enforce 3y for token-level logs, but canonical key-handshake proofs are harder to prune without an export step.
Maya R: Ok — can we draft a minimal artifact mapping? Put rough table here and I'll route to legal/solutions.
Jordan P: Sure. Draft table:
```
artifact          pilot-retention    enterprise-offer
stream-audit-log   3y (auto-tier)     7y
keystore-handshake 7y                 7y
evidence-pack      7y                 7y
token-level-log    3y                 7y
kms-metadata       7y                 7y
```
Samir: Implementation note: plan = `tier after 90d -> cold tier -> export to encrypted archive at 3y` for pilot, with a manual retention-unlock for legal requests.
Ina (Legal): That mapping is reasonable. Two asks: (1) add an access/chain-of-custody stamp on evidence-packs, and (2) add a path for legal-hold overrides (temporary freeze).
Kevin: We can add a `legal-hold` flag on the retention service. Work estimate: 3 engineer-days to wire flag + 2 days for tests + rollout doc.
Maya R: Action items:
- Jordan: finalize mapping and update product PRD (owner) :point_right: Jordan P
- Kevin + Samir: prototype `legal-hold` + tiering playbook (owner) :point_right: Kevin
- Ina: confirm auditor language and minimal retention wording (owner) :point_right: Ina (Legal)
ops-bot: snapshot created for env=staging retention-proto at 2026-03-18T18:22:10Z
Jordan P: I'll aim to have PRD update by EOD Friday. If legal ok, we commit pilot messaging and ticket customers.
Samir: I'll draft the retention lifecycle runbook and cost delta estimate.
Ina (Legal): Will confirm recommended auditor language by Tue. If anything changes we escalate to compliance WG.
Maya R: Decision (tentative): For APAC pilot, ship with 3y for standard audit logs (auto-tier) + 7y for keystore/key proofs and evidence-packs; legal-hold override implemented. Final signoff pending Ina.
Kevin: Noted. We'll add a migration/export path to preserve proofs before any purge.
Maya R: Thanks everyone. Small follow-up: any customer-facing phrasing suggestions? keep it simple: "Default retention: 3 years for operational logs; cryptographic proofs/keystore metadata retained 7 years. Legal hold and enterprise options available."
Ina (Legal): That phrasing is OK, add: "Customers may request longer retention under enterprise agreements."
Jordan P: Copy for docs drafted, will circulate. :+1:
Maya R: Closing thread — will post updated PRD once Jordan publishes.
